answers.core:
There is no way currently to customize "Create New Project" screen from add-ons.

However, implementing this proposal will allow such a customization as a side effect.
answers.workaround: No. Currently, the "Create New Project" window is separate from templates. This proposal is about integrating (a selection of) templates into the "Create New Project" window.

title: Integrate templates for a new project into "Create New Project" window
